reviews.title: Affordable but Lacking
reviews.text:
A good effort, I can see the developer means well. Unfortunately, this app is missing some basic functionality that is essential for an app such as a habit/routine tracker. 

I would save the couple bucks and find an app that’s more developed and has more active support. Nothing in this app has improved in the few months I’ve used it. 

Example of missing functionality:
- Unable to view tasks in a routine without editing the routine, or starting the whole routine and having to go through each item one at a time. There’s no way to simply say “I did this thing but not the others”
- Default view is the only view, there’s no way to see only what’s currently due. The default view shows all tasks for the whole day, with no way to change the default filter. 
- Badge app icon shows number of items for the whole day, not the number of items pending completion now - again, no way to customize. 

For a habit tracker, the lack of ability to customize preferences or be presented with items the way I’d like to be, is very disappointing. Save your dollars.

Edit: The development team reached out and stated they are working on adding these features. In return, I am working on taking down my negative review. I expect they’ll both be completed around the same time.

reviews.title: Great app but needs some tweaks
reviews.text: The previous habit I was using a change their design and seems that it’s a lot more focused on one gender and their particular goals.  This is a great overall habit app, but really needs some tweaks.  I like getting notifications, but they only have very limited responses.   If I intend to do a habit, but not right at this moment, I’d like the option to be reminded a little bit later. Like later in an hour Or this afternoon or whatever is appropriate for my frequency.   It also would be nice if there might be some tutorial videos on how to get started because it took me an hour so I have to figure out how to make it work i’m still not sure about some of the logic of the functions.  I’d pay for this if it had some adjustments in usability.

reviews.title: Almost Perfect
reviews.text:
Let’s start with what I LOVE: 

 Visually: 
 • the red, yellow, & green 
 • the number of days missed 
 • you can choose to see everything on the timeline or choose a group 

 Function: 
 • the calendar 
 • the journal 
 • the progress and stats 
 • the timers 
 • the ability to add one time tasks or events  

Now for what I NEED: 

I need to be able to disable the time for some of the tasks and the ability to drag and drop to reorder the tasks.

I don’t always do things at the same time of day BUT I like to do them in a certain order. Even if I choose morning, afternoon, or evening, I can’t change the order. 

 I keep coming back to this app only to abandon it again. If you could make these two changes this app would be PERFECT! I could you this app to manage my whole life!
